description: Health and monitoring dashboard for Ansible Automation Platform running as a containerized deployment on RHEL. Uses only awx_* and controller metrics from the /api/controller/v2/metrics/ endpoint.

panels.description: Controller instances registered in the cluster with their hostname, version, and node type. Data comes from the awx_instance_info gauge metric.
panels.title: Instance Info

panels.description: Percentage of total capacity consumed per controller instance. Green < 70%, yellow 70-90%, red >= 90%.
panels.title: Instance Capacity

panels.description: Remaining execution capacity (fork slots) available per controller instance. Low values indicate the instance is near its execution limit.
panels.title: Instance Remaining Capacity

panels.description: Number of automation jobs currently executing across all controller instances.
panels.title: Running Jobs

panels.description: Jobs waiting in the queue to be picked up by a controller task worker. High pending count may indicate capacity issues.
panels.title: Pending Jobs

panels.description: Total number of jobs that ended in 'failed' or 'error' status. A rising count may indicate playbook issues or infrastructure problems.
panels.title: Failed Jobs

panels.description: Jobs blocked by dependency constraints (e.g., waiting for a parent workflow node to complete). High blocked count may indicate workflow design issues or a failed upstream job holding the pipeline.
panels.title: Blocked Tasks

panels.description: Percentage of total controller capacity (fork slots) currently consumed by running jobs. Yellow at 70%, red at 90% -- indicates the controller is running out of execution capacity.
panels.title: Consumed Capacity

panels.description: Time-series breakdown of all job statuses over time: Running, Successful, Failed, Error, Canceled, Waiting, Pending, and Blocked.
panels.title: Job Launched Statistics

panels.description: Processing time for the controller task manager and callback receiver. High values indicate the controller is slow to process events or start tasks.
panels.title: Gateway / API Processing Time

panels.description: Time spent on PostgreSQL transactions: committing task state, loading pending/workflow tasks from DB, and writing callback events. High values indicate database pressure.
panels.title: PostgreSQL Transaction Latency

panels.description: Time spent in the task manager processing pipeline: loading, starting, and processing running and pending tasks. High values indicate job scheduling bottlenecks.
panels.title: Task Manager Execution Time

panels.description: Total active PostgreSQL connections reported by the Controller metrics endpoint. Red at 0 (no connections), yellow at 1-2 (thin pool), green at 3 or more.
panels.title: DB Connections

panels.description: Callback receiver metrics: Redis event queue depth (events waiting to be written to DB), events held in memory, and average processing time per event. A growing queue indicates the system cannot keep up with event volume. Shows 'No data' when no jobs are running and the callback receiver is idle.
panels.title: Event Processing (Callback Receiver)

title: AAP - Health & Monitoring (Containerized)
